risks.title: Sale exit is stated without supporting detail
risks.message: The only exit given is 'sale of the warehouse at the end of the term'. The application has no marketing plan, expected sale price or timing, and no evidence of buyer demand. The borrower is a logistics company and appears to operate from this warehouse, so a sale implies relocation or a sale-and-leaseback. Neither is explained. The facility also increases secured debt from $7.9m to $8.4m. The credit officer may want the broker to show how the sale is credible and achievable within the 24-month term.
